question: Can a single reusable runner emit the PRODUCT_AGNOSTIC 'Evaluation Output' compatibility-and-behavior matrix from the already-available artifacts, separating contract failure from policy quality per cell — the doc's stated FIRST deliverable (C-1)?
plan: PRODUCT_AGNOSTIC.md ordered action plan step 2 (build the verification matrix CSV); combined ladder C-1; also supplies the missing apples-to-apples C0 row.

method.runner: tokenomics.eval.transfer_matrix — StackSpec x TargetTopology -> one row; transfer_matrix(...) emits the full matrix; write_matrix_csv emits the canonical columns. Every stack runs on the SAME joint env (joint_stack_env: entity_producer_obs + corrected v4 product-stream ordering) so deterministic bars and portable modules are apples-to-apples.
method.stacks: noop+proportional (floor); entity_planner+proportional (practical bar = ratio denominator); stock_aware+proportional; portable_producer+proportional (C0 producer side, EXP-0013 ckpt); stock_aware+portable_orderer (C0 orderer side, EXP-0012 ckpt); portable_producer+portable_orderer (C1 full stack, EXP-0014).
method.targets: train-size held-out scale seeds 6-9 at depth 3 (P=12) + one capacity-relabel target (scale-d3-s6-relabel) for the same-shape relabel axis. Size/out-of-family targets are later rungs (C2 step 4 / C3 step 6).

metric: Per cell: producer/orderer schema_loads + contract_compatible flags, runs_episode, failure_class, consumer_completed_units, dead_rate, and ratio_vs_practical_baseline (vs entity_planner+proportional on the SAME target). Floor (noop) proves the target is nontrivial; the relabel target proves same-shape equivariance (value-identical here — the matrix records aggregate value; full byte-identical incl. cycles is EXP-0014's joint_stack.relabel_gate).
pass: The matrix runner emits the canonical CSV columns (contract test); a loaded-but-incompatible checkpoint becomes a contract-failure row instead of raising (contract test); the floor reads 0 units; every runnable cell records value separately from contract flags; the relabel target is value-identical to its base seed for every stack; portable cells reproduce EXP-0012/0013/0014 numbers.
notes: Local eval only (HARD RULE: evaluation of existing checkpoints, no training). No legacy fixed-contract checkpoint included here, so all rows are contract-compatible (zero contract failures) — legacy-incompatible cells appear once a flat GaussianActor ckpt is pointed at an off-size target (later rung). Out-of-family recipe targets (P2/O3/C3) are NOT covered.
